## Rate Limits

| Endpoint group | Limit |
| -------------- | ----- |
| Read requests | 600 per minute per key |
| Write requests | 120 per minute per key |
| Device sync | 4 per minute per device |
| Exports | 10 running per workspace |

A request over the limit is answered `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header. The SDKs retry automatically, honouring it.

## Quotas

| Resource | Free | Team | Enterprise |
| -------- | ---- | ---- | ---------- |
| Devices | 5 | 100 | unlimited |
| Surveys | 3 | unlimited | unlimited |
| Attachment storage | 5 GB | 500 GB | by contract |
| Export retention | 7 days | 30 days | 90 days |

:::note
Retired devices do not count towards the device quota. Asleep devices do.
:::

<Icon name="information" class="inline-icon" /> Enterprise quotas are set per contract; ask your account manager for the numbers that apply to you.
